tasks.acceptance: An error-level failed-message query with a 20 ms minimum duration reports only matching valid records.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves filtering, grouping, and checked duration-report capability without executing a trial.
tasks.goal: Preserve filtered NDJSON duration aggregation while adding its regression coverage.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; NdjsonOptions and NdjsonResult remain the interface.

tasks.acceptance: A stream containing an invalid UTF-8 byte raises the typed InvalidUtf8 application error.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves deterministic rejection of non-text input; no file mutation or trial execution is allowed.
tasks.goal: Reject malformed NDJSON byte streams before line-level analysis.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; analyze_ndjson keeps its existing error contract.

tasks.acceptance: The valid command exits successfully, writes its report to stdout, and leaves stderr empty.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves the command-to-report bridge and success/error stream separation without a trial run.
tasks.goal: Keep the NDJSON CLI adapter aligned with analyzer output for a valid filtered invocation.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; run_ndjson_cli continues to return ProductiveCliRun.

tasks.acceptance: A record with no duration remains valid and contributes no duration sample to aggregate duration output.
acceptance_outputs: duration metrics use only present duration_ms values
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves partial-record analytics without introducing an implicit zero-duration capability.
tasks.goal: Maintain optional duration handling so valid matching records without duration do not corrupt duration metrics.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; the optional duration_ms field remains optional.

tasks.acceptance: A duration or counter addition beyond UInt64 is rejected through the typed application error path.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves bounded arithmetic and prevents wraparound; no benchmark or agent execution is permitted.
tasks.goal: Protect NDJSON counters and duration accumulation from unsigned-64 overflow.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; overflow remains represented by ProductiveApplicationError.

tasks.acceptance: The report emits error before later groups and api before db for the established fixture order.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves deterministic observable report ordering without changing map implementation or running a trial.
tasks.goal: Retain first-seen ordering for NDJSON level and service report groups.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; tuple-shaped group results retain their established order.

tasks.acceptance: Quoted product names containing delimiters contribute exact checked revenue to both groupings.
acceptance_outputs: revenue_by_product includes Widget, large=250 and Gadget=600
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves CSV parsing and deterministic revenue grouping without issuing a trial command.
tasks.goal: Preserve CSV quoting support while aggregating revenue by product and region.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; CsvOptions and CsvResult remain the interface.

tasks.acceptance: The overflow fixture raises RevenueOverflow instead of wrapping or emitting a partial report.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves checked revenue arithmetic and rejects unsafe capability expansion to wrapped totals.
tasks.goal: Reject a CSV row whose quantity-times-unit-price revenue exceeds UInt64.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; aggregate_csv continues to signal arithmetic failure with ProductiveApplicationError.

tasks.acceptance: The command exits with zero, emits the checked revenue report, and emits no stderr text.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves CSV command output routing without trial execution or changes to other applications.
tasks.goal: Keep the CSV CLI adapter aligned with aggregate_csv for a valid comma-delimited source.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; run_csv_cli continues to return ProductiveCliRun.

tasks.acceptance: The mixed fixture reports two valid rows, two invalid rows, quantity five, and revenue 850 cents.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves partial-input aggregation without granting malformed rows a revenue effect.
tasks.goal: Count structurally malformed and non-numeric CSV rows as invalid while retaining valid-row totals.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; CsvResult valid and invalid counters remain the interface.

tasks.acceptance: The established fixture reports Widget, large before Gadget and north before south.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves observable insertion order without altering the deterministic map implementation or executing a trial.
tasks.goal: Preserve first-seen deterministic ordering for CSV product and region revenue groups.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; ordered tuple group results remain unchanged.

tasks.acceptance: An invalid delimiter fails before parsing instead of producing an ambiguous aggregation result.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves byte-delimited CSV capability and prevents unsupported multi-byte delimiter behavior.
tasks.goal: Reject delimiters that cannot represent exactly one UTF-8 byte.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; CsvOptions.delimiter remains the sole delimiter parameter.

tasks.acceptance: The alpha query matches Alpha, ALPHABET, and the unterminated last alpha line only.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves exact text-search capability without silently expanding it to Unicode case folding or running a trial.
tasks.goal: Keep grep-style matching ASCII-case-insensitive without applying Unicode case folding.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; GrepOptions.ignore_case keeps ASCII-only semantics.

tasks.acceptance: The alpha ignore-case fixture emits exactly 3 followed by a newline and no matched-line text.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves the compact count mode without granting it line-output effects or executing a trial.
tasks.goal: Preserve count-only grep output as one decimal count followed by one newline.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; GrepResult.output continues to carry count-only text.

tasks.acceptance: A source containing an invalid byte raises InvalidUtf8 rather than returning partial match output.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves all-or-nothing text input validation and forbids partial-output trial behavior.
tasks.goal: Reject invalid UTF-8 text sources before line matching.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; search_text retains the existing typed error contract.

tasks.acceptance: The valid command exits zero, emits exactly the first matching line, and leaves stderr empty.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves grep command output routing while prohibiting any agent or command trial execution.
tasks.goal: Keep the grep CLI adapter aligned with case-insensitive matching output.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; run_grep_cli continues to return ProductiveCliRun.

tasks.acceptance: A missing --contains value exits with code two, writes no stdout, and reports family=missing on stderr.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves deterministic error-channel behavior without modifying the shared parser or executing a trial.
tasks.goal: Keep grep CLI argument failures typed and isolated from stdout.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; ProductiveCliRun continues to represent argument errors.

tasks.acceptance: A no-match search returns zero matching lines and an empty normal-mode output string.
tasks.effect_capability_impact: Preserves a non-error no-match capability without adding implicit diagnostics or running a trial.
tasks.goal: Preserve empty matched-line output when a nonempty text source has no exact matches.
tasks.interface_impact: No public API change; GrepResult keeps zero counts and text output as its interface.
